apiKey.label: Apify API Token
apiKey.help: Apify personal API token used for both web search and web fetch (fallback: APIFY_API_KEY env var).

webFetch.crawlerType.label: Fetch Crawler Type
webFetch.crawlerType.help: Crawler engine for web fetch. Use playwright:firefox for JS-heavy or bot-protected pages; cheerio for fast plain-HTML pages.

webFetch.timeoutSeconds.label: Fetch Timeout (seconds)
webFetch.timeoutSeconds.help: Maximum seconds to wait for the website-content-crawler actor to respond (1–300).

webSearch.maxResults.label: Search Max Results
webSearch.maxResults.help: Maximum number of search results to return (1–10, capped by OpenClaw core).

webSearch.timeoutSeconds.label: Search Timeout (seconds)
webSearch.timeoutSeconds.help: Maximum seconds to wait for the rag-web-browser actor to respond (1–300).
